'''Fudbalski klub Budućnost Banovići''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club from the town of [[Banovići]] that is situated in the eastern part of [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

The club plays its home matches at the Gradski Stadion (City Stadium) in Banovići,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-08-26 |title="Pakleni derbi": Stadion u Banovićima odavno nije bio popunjeniji |url=https://faktor.ba/sport/fudbal/pakleni-derbi-stadion-u-banovicima-odavno-nije-bio-popunjeniji/165257 |access-date=2026-03-15 |website=faktor.ba |language=bs}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Ološ uništavao Gradski stadion u Banovićima – FK Budućnost Banovići se oglasio saopštenjem za javnost i stavio veto na kompleks stadiona! |url=https://sportskevijesti.com/2024/10/25/olos-unistavao-gradski-stadion-u-banovicima-fk-buducnost-banovici-se-oglasio-saopstenjem-za-javnost-i-stavio-veto-na-kompleks-stadiona/ |access-date=2026-03-15 |website=Sportske Vijesti |language=bs-BA}}</ref> also called Stadion FK Budućnost, which has a capacity of 8,500 seats.{{Citation needed|date=March 2026}} Their primary colors are dark green and black.

Today, Budućnost is a member of the [[Football Association of Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The club is active in the [[First League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina]], which is the [[Bosnia and Herzegovina football league system|second division of football]] in Bosnia and Herzegovina.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sportsport.ba/fudbal/fudbaleri-banovica-se-plasirali-u-prvu-ligu-fbih-pa-napravili-nezapamceno-slavlje/319814|title=Fudbaleri Banovića se plasirali u Prvu ligu FBiH, pa napravili nezapamćeno slavlje|date=22 May 2019|access-date=22 May 2019|language=bs|author=A.
